children.description: I have found a homeless shelter in Seattle called the Downtown Emergency Service Center (DESC Seattle). It is located at 515 3rd Ave S, Seattle, WA 98104. The coordinates for the shelter are 47.60220599249109,-122.33136101734422. You can contact them at (206) 464-1570 or email them at info@desc.org.
